title: Stock Portfolio Momentum
description: An investor tracks the daily return multipliers of a volatile stock over a period of time. Find the contiguous sequence of days within the given array of numbers that has the largest product of returns, and return that product.
constraints: The product of any prefix or suffix of nums is guaranteed to fit in a 32-bit integer.
input_format: An integer array nums representing daily return multipliers.
output_format: An integer representing the maximum product of a contiguous subarray.

examples.explanation: The result cannot be 2, because [-2, -1] is not a contiguous subarray.
